introNote: The short lore opening of each warband, summarised in our own words from the first paragraphs of its page on mordheimer.net (read 31.10.2026) – never copied. Offered as the default text of a warband's Prologue (the player adopts it with one tap). Not rules data; nothing here is playable. Ostermark has only a section of the Mercenaries page, so its entry points at that section.
loreNote: The description of each unit as its page on mordheimer.net words it, verbatim (read 7.11.2026 with curl), offered as the default of a warrior's story ("A few lines about him"); the player's own text replaces it. Taken over word for word at Rob's wish of 7.11.2026, an exception to ADR 0024 for this one purpose. Not rules data; nothing here is playable. A unit whose page has no description has no entry.
